grammar:
char ::= [^"\\\x00-\x1F] | [\\] (["\\bfnrt] | "u" [0-9a-fA-F]{4})
response-format-schema ::= "{" space response-format-schema-operation-kv "," space response-format-schema-target-kv "," space response-format-schema-objective-kv "," space response-format-schema-reason-kv "," space response-format-schema-preserve-kv ( "," space response-format-schema-denoise-kv )? space "}"
response-format-schema-denoise ::= ("0." [0-9]* [1-9] [0-9]* | "1" ("." "0"+)?)
response-format-schema-denoise-kv ::= "\"denoise\"" space ":" space response-format-schema-denoise
response-format-schema-objective ::= "\"" char{3,1200} "\""
response-format-schema-objective-kv ::= "\"objective\"" space ":" space response-format-schema-objective
response-format-schema-operation ::= ("\"keep\"" | "\"regenerate\"" | "\"handoff\"" | "\"sketch\"" | "\"local_edit\"" | "\"stop\"")
response-format-schema-operation-kv ::= "\"operation\"" space ":" space response-format-schema-operation
response-format-schema-preserve ::= "\"" char{0,1200} "\""
response-format-schema-preserve-kv ::= "\"preserve\"" space ":" space response-format-schema-preserve
response-format-schema-reason ::= "\"" char{3,1500} "\""
response-format-schema-reason-kv ::= "\"reason\"" space ":" space response-format-schema-reason
response-format-schema-target ::= ("\"newbie\"" | "\"illustrious\"" | "\"anima\"" | "\"z_image_turbo\"")
response-format-schema-target-kv ::= "\"target\"" space ":" space response-format-schema-target
root ::= response-format-schema
space ::= [ \t\n\r]*

transformation.changed: Derive an explicit text-only NextChoice grammar; no source schema constraint changes
transformation.unchanged: Exact keys, required first five members, optional denoise, both enums, all string minima/maxima, numeric 0 < denoise <= 1 and host default 0.25
transformation.method: Normal-turn text-only preflight compatibility check for the frozen NextChoice schema; not an observed NextChoice failure and not validation of general automatic schema conversion
transformation.length_scope: All original NextChoice string bounds retained: objective 3..1200, reason 3..1500, preserve 0..1200; equivalent complete grammar parsed in the exact installed NULL-vocab sampler. Complete schema and host Pydantic validation remain authoritative; reject without repair.
transformation.numeric_scope: Sampler accepts valid JSON decimal spelling without exponents, restricted to 0 < denoise <= 1; omitting denoise preserves the original host default 0.25. The unchanged host schema retains original numeric bounds and default.
transformation.input_scope: Text-only ordinary next-turn selection; no visual profile permission or resource changes
transformation.source_runtime_scope: The source directory identifies diagnostics for this exact installed DLL build; it is not a NextChoice response or failure receipt
